desc: Compute prefix sum arrays for `nums` and `cost` to enable O(1) range sum queries.
Initialize a DP array of size `n + 1` with infinity, setting `dp[0] = 0`.
Iterate `i` from 1 to `n` (representing the end of the current prefix).
Inside the loop, iterate `j` from `0` to `i-1` (representing the start of the current subarray).
Calculate the number of subarrays before the current one as `subarrays_before = i - j - 1` and the current subarray index as `subarrays_current = i - j`.
Compute the sum of `nums` and `cost` for the range `[j, i-1]` using the prefix arrays.
Calculate the cost of the current subarray: `(nums_sum + k * subarrays_current) * cost_sum`.
Implement the DP with Pareto frontier.
